controlChangeCommands.name: Bank Select
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Bank Select MSB (CC0). FIX map: 0=U001-U125, 1=U126-U250, 2=P001-P125, 3=P126-P250; PC 0-124 within bank. LSB (CC32) received as 0. Internal patch IDs use U01-1..U50-5 / P01-1..P50-5 (GT-1000 only). Assign CCs user-config only (CC1-31, CC64-95). 5-pin DIN MIDI IN/OUT. GT-1000 MIDI Implementation v3.20.
